title: Charming 2BR Apt Near Downtown Nashville- Sleeps 6
description:
Relax in this chic 2BR apartment, only 8 minutes from downtown Nashville. Enjoy all the city has to offer, and come back to a comfy space designed for rest and relaxation.

The space
★ LIVING ROOM ★ (Sleeps 2)
Perfect for relaxing or spending time with friends and family while watching a movie or show.
✔ Comfortable sofas with pillows
✔ Flat-screen TV
✔ Coffee table
✔ Twin bed (sleeps 1)
✔ Pull-out sofa (sleeps 1)

★ KITCHEN ★
Located at the top of the stairs, the fully equipped kitchen offers everything you need to cook or enjoy a break from restaurants.
✔ Microwave
✔ Stove & oven
✔ Refrigerator / freezer
✔ Dishwasher
✔ Toaster
✔ Sink with hot & cold water
✔ Trays
✔ Glassware & silverware
✔ Pots & pans

★ BEDROOMS (2) ★
Rest easy in a comfortable bedroom designed for a perfect night’s sleep.
✔ Queen-size bed with linens, pillows, and sheets
✔ Wardrobe with hangers and shelves

★ BATHROOM ★
Spacious full bathroom stocked with essentials for a hassle-free stay.
✔ Mirror
✔ Toilet
✔ Towels
✔ Basic toiletries

Guest access
The apartment is all yours for the duration of your stay, so you can relax, unwind, and truly feel at home.

In addition to the amenities already mentioned, the apartment also offers:
✔ High-speed Wi-Fi
✔ Air conditioning
✔ Heating
✔ Ceiling fan
✔ In-unit washer and dryer

Other things to note
Frequently Asked Questions:

How far is it from Broadway?
It’s an 8-minute drive.

Can we check in early or drop off bags?
We try to stick to our 4 PM check-in time. We recommend using a luggage drop-off service, such as Bounce Luggage Storage in The Gulch or Nashville Luggage Drop.

- Is it free parking? 

No. You need to register your car and pay for the parking fee via the QR code to park your car in the property.

Here's the parking rate:

- $32 per night for a stay of 1 to 2 nights
- $32 per night with a 40% discount for stays of 3 or more nights using a discount code (to be provided, please message us upon arrival)

If our parking lot is full, overflow & free parking is available at the Burger King and Sonic across the street. Please note that 25th Hour is not liable for any damage to vehicles parked in these areas.
